name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Mabel, Perch, and Foxglen belong to different catches.
Gus goes with neither Foxglen nor Stillwater.
The angler at Pinehollow belongs to the Catfish Family.
Trout goes with at least one of Gus or Pinehollow.
Pike goes with either Dale or Grayreach (but not both).
Crappie goes with either Royce or Grayreach (but not both).
Dale, Perch, and Cedarmere belong to different catches.
The angler at Foxglen does not belong to the Pike Family.
The angler at Foxglen and Royce are in different families.
